start_here: Say to your AI: "Take <their login> out of <my pursuit's database>."
no_lists_because: Who may work in a pursuit is the database's own logins; leaving is dropping one.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit's database and the login to end.

3. When their login was made by the computer's login that may make logins (login_maker when they were let in), give that same login_maker: the pursuit's owner takes back their rights, then it drops the login.
4. Their rights are taken back and the login dropped; the changes they made stay, still told as theirs.

worked_examples.title: End a coach's access
worked_examples.ask: Take sam_coach out of the club database.
worked_examples.given: sam_coach was let in with workflow:let-a-person-into-a-pursuit.
worked_examples.hands_back: role "sam_coach", gone true, said "sam_coach no longer works in club; their changes stay in its history."
